Fly anatomy derived from https://github.com/TuragaLab/flybody
Commit d015e9bfe441bd90ae431bac24c55cb74bdbce26
License: Apache-2.0, included in FLYBODY-LICENSE.txt.
Changes by Money Follows Fly: mesh simplification, coordinate conversion,
binary packaging and an authored browser gait. No physical simulation or
upstream pretrained locomotion policy is used at runtime.

Measured neural response assets derive from FlyWire FAFB v783 data and the
Shiu et al. computational model using flypoke. Cite Dorkenwald et al., Nature
2024, doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07558-y; Schlegel et al., Nature 2024,
doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07686-5; Shiu et al., Nature 2024,
doi:10.1038/s41586-024-07763-9. See research.html and responses.json for
source versions, transformations and hashes. FlyWire data attribution: CC BY 4.0.
flypoke and Shiu code licenses are included alongside this notice.

Three.js 0.180.0 is locally bundled under MIT, with its license in vendor/.
The author of the meme/interview did not endorse or participate in this project.
